epic.name: Land on the screen your role uses
unverifiedAssumptions: Verify that your real accounts each hold just one of the two roles: this epic decides where to send someone from the roles the sign-in service reports for them. If real Approver accounts also carry Importer (or the other way round), those people will keep landing on the "What you can do" screen and will not notice any change — which may not be what you expected from this epic.

Known wrinkle, found in code review rather than by a test — worth a look and a decision from you. If you are already on your own screen and you click the app's name in the header, the browser records that as a second visit to the screen you are already on. The screen looks right, but the first Back press then appears to do nothing (it takes you from that screen back to the same screen). Before this epic that click took you to the "What you can do" screen, so the entry meant something. Fixing it means changing what the app-name link does for everyone, which would cost people holding both roles a back step on their way to the chooser — so I left it as it is rather than trade one wrinkle for another. Tell me if you would rather it were fixed.
